item_name: Rothco X Bear Archery Fred Bear Camo Low Profile Cap
item_short_desc: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary outdoor apparel and gear, including our Low Profile Cap. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern.
description: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary outdoor apparel and gear, including our Low Profile Cap. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern. Everyday Essential: In addition to shielding your eyes from the sun’s rays, the Fred Bear Camo Low Profile Cap is a great compliment to any outfit. From an evening at the archery range to a weekend trip in the mountains, this baseball hat offers superior comfort and a perfect fit for any activity. As Strong as an Ox: These camouflage hats are built with a 55% cotton / 45% polyester twill blend for unmatched resiliency and easy-to-care-for maintenance. The buckram front panels provide the ultimate foundation of a strong and solid design. These baseball caps will hold their shape for years to come. Keep Cool, Stay Focused: This camo hat features a top-notch sweatband that keeps sweat away from your eyes for comfortable all-day wear. The 6 vents on the top help circulate airflow around your head, allowing you to focus on the task at hand. One Size Fits Most: Our hats use an adjustable hook and loop closure for a snug fit that is perfect for most head sizes, ensuring that the cap stays in place when you are out in the wilderness.
